source.published_natural_experiment: LaRue et al. 2013, PLOS ONE, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0060568

published_capacity_change.banded_bird_interisland_emigration_patte: Beaufort-to-Ross-Island emigration/visitation peaked near 3% in 2005 then declined as Beaufort habitat availability increased

boundary: The aerial-count decomposition is descriptive and does not identify individual movement.
The movement inference comes from independent band/resighting evidence in LaRue et al. 2013.
The Beaufort natural experiment does not establish a universal threshold across penguin colonies.
Ross Island itself contains multiple colonies, so the demographic hierarchy is nested rather than purely island-level.
